DuckSheets is a free spreadsheet for Windows that opens and saves Excel workbooks (.xlsx) and CSV files. It has formulas with about 110 of Excel's functions, formatting, sorting, filtering, frozen panes and charts, and keeps everything in your Excel files that it doesn't edit itself.

## Install

1. Download **DuckSheets-Setup.exe** below. That one file is all you need.
2. Run it. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Open DuckSheets from the Start menu, or right-click an Excel file and choose **Open with**.

It needs Windows 10 or 11. Your files stay on your computer; DuckSheets goes online only to check for updates.

The "Source code" files below are added by GitHub automatically; you don't need them.
